title: Government of Ireland Postgraduate Scholarship Programme 2027
provider: Research Ireland (Taighde Éireann) / Department of Further and Higher Education, Research, Innovation and Science
funding_type: Full scholarship with stipend, fees contribution, and research costs
eligibility_summary: Open to new entrants to a Master's or PhD programme or registered students in the first year of the degree. Applicants must hold a first-class or upper-second-class honours bachelor's degree (or equivalent). Must be affiliated with an eligible Research Body. Open to all nationalities. Must not currently or previously hold a Research Ireland scholarship (except one that enabled a master's degree).
funding_details: Up to €34,000 per annum: stipend €25,000/year; fees contribution up to €5,750/year (additional €4,000/year for non-EU nationals); eligible direct research costs €3,250/year.
duration: 1-4 years (2 years for research master's, 4 years for PhD; partial funding available for those in first year)

title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES) 2027/28
provider: Higher Education Authority (HEA) / Government of Ireland
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss/UK domiciled students with an offer of admission from an eligible Irish HEI for full-time NFQ Level 9 or 10 study. Must not have previously held a GOI-IES scholarship. Russian and Belarusian nationals are ineligible.
funding_details: Full tuition fee waiver (including registration charges) + €10,000 stipend for one year, payable in two instalments.

title: Ireland Fellows Programme 2027/2028
provider: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Irish Aid)
funding_type: Fully funded (fees, flights, accommodation, living costs, insurance)
application_deadline: Stage 2: 18 October 2026 (by invitation only after Stage 1)
eligibility_summary: Early to mid-career professionals from eligible countries (Africa, Asia, Latin America, Caribbean, Pacific, Palestine) with leadership potential. Must hold a relevant bachelor's degree, have required work experience, and not already hold a master's qualification. Must be in a position to take up the Fellowship in 2027/2028.
funding_details: Full programme fees, return flights, visa fees, medical insurance, travel insurance, residence permit fee, living allowance (approx. €700/month), and accommodation support.

title: UCD Global Excellence Scholarship 2027/28
application_deadline: To be confirmed (2026/27 deadlines: 1 Feb, 28 Feb, 31 Mar 2026 by region)
eligibility_summary: Non-EU tuition fee status only. Must hold an offer or conditional offer for an eligible undergraduate or graduate taught programme at UCD. Some programmes excluded (e.g., Smurfit Business School, Medicine, etc.). Citizens of China are not eligible for Global Excellence Scholarship.
funding_details: 100% or 50% tuition fee scholarship, applied as a reduction to tuition fees. Limited number of awards per region.

title: Trinity College Dublin Global Excellence Postgraduate Scholarships 2026/27
application_deadline: Regional deadlines: Africa 1 May 2026; Central/North/South America 1 April 2026; South East Asia & Oceania 15 July 2026; All other regions 15 June 2026
eligibility_summary: Non-EU fee status. Must have a course offer for a full-time postgraduate taught programme at TCD for 2026/27. Business, engineering, natural sciences, and computer science/statistics courses are exempt. Students from China are not eligible.
funding_details: One-time tuition fee reduction between €2,000 and €5,000 depending on region.

title: University of Galway Global Scholarships 2026/27
eligibility_summary: Non-EU countries. Merit-based awards across colleges. Specific college scholarships available for Science & Engineering, Business, Public Policy & Law, etc.
funding_details: Excellence scholarships: €5,000–€10,000 per year. Merit scholarships: €5,000 per year. Region-based scholarships vary.

title: University of Galway - China Scholarship Council Joint Scholarship for PhD Study 2026-2027
provider: University of Galway / China Scholarship Council (CSC)
funding_type: Full tuition fee waiver + living costs and airfare (CSC)
application_deadline: CSC portal: 31 March 2026; Trinity deadline: 20 February 2026 (for supervisor shortlisting)
eligibility_summary: Chinese citizens and permanent residents (excluding Macau, Hong Kong, Taiwan). Under 35 years. Must hold an unconditional offer from University of Galway. Current master's students, final-year undergraduates, working professionals with bachelor's+, or self-funded first-year doctoral students at Trinity may apply.
funding_details: Full tuition fee waiver from University of Galway (up to 15 PhD places). Living costs and flight tickets provided by CSC. Bench fees, conference travel, and research expenses not included.

title: Hardiman Research Scholarships 2026
eligibility_summary: High-achieving individuals commencing PhD on 1 September 2026. Must not be currently registered as a PhD student or previously awarded a PhD. Must nominate one supervisor.
funding_details: €25,000 per annum stipend + full tuition fee coverage for 4 years. Does not cover student levy, consumables, or travel.
status: CLOSED (next cycle opens early December 2026 for 2027 entry)

title: DCU International Scholarships for Non-EU Students 2027-28
application_deadline: To be confirmed (automatic consideration upon offer)
application_opening_date: To be confirmed (applications for September 2027 entry open October 2026)
eligibility_summary: Non-EU applicants who have received an offer to study at DCU. Automatic consideration upon application to DCU. No separate application required for most faculty scholarships. Varies by faculty: Humanities & Social Sciences, Engineering & Computing, Business, Science & Health.
funding_details: Faculty-specific fee reductions: Humanities €1,850–€2,000; Engineering €4,400–€5,000; Business €2,000–€2,800; Science & Health €3,100–€6,100 per year.

title: DCU Doctoral Research Scholarships 2026-2027
provider: Dublin City University (DCU) School of English
eligibility_summary: Relevant undergraduate degree at first-class or 2.1 level; relevant master's qualification desirable. Must be available to register and begin full-time research before October 2026.
funding_details: €25,000 per annum stipend + fee waiver for up to four years, subject to satisfactory annual progression.

title: Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme 2026
provider: Research Ireland (Taighde Éireann) / Department of Further and Higher Education, Research, Innovation and Science
eligibility_summary: Suitably qualified postdoctoral candidates pursuing full-time research in any discipline. Must be hosted at an eligible higher education institution in Ireland.
funding_details: Salary €46,305 (Year 1) and €47,879 (Year 2); employer's PRSI contribution; eligible direct research expenses €5,000 per annum.
status: CLOSED (next cycle expected late 2026 for 2027 start)

title: Royal Society – Research Ireland University Research Fellowship 2026
eligibility_summary: Early career postdoctoral researchers with 3-8 years of research experience since PhD (career breaks considered). Must be hosted within a Research Ireland Eligible Research Body in the Republic of Ireland.
funding_details: Funding for 8 years (years 6-8 subject to mid-fellowship review). Fellowship must commence between 1 October 2026 and 1 January 2027.
status: CLOSED (next cycle expected mid-2026 for 2027 start)

title: Research Ireland Public Service Fellowship 2026
eligibility_summary: Must hold a PhD. Must be a permanent academic staff member or current contract postdoctoral researcher at an Eligible Research Body in Ireland. 71 projects available across 26 Government Departments and Agencies.
funding_details: Maximum €130,000 direct costs. Duration 6-12 months full-time or 12-24 months part-time. Hybrid working arrangements available.

title: SEAI Energise Fellowship Programme 2026 – Academic Fellowships
eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral or experienced researchers with a relevant PhD. Must have support of a 3rd Level Educational Body in the Republic of Ireland. Welcomes applicants returning to research after a career break.
funding_details: Funding details per call document. Fellowship must commence within 6 months of notification.

title: UCD Global Excellence Scholarship 2026/27
application_deadline: North America UG: 1 Feb 2026; Middle East/Africa/Pakistan & South Asia Grad: 28 Feb 2026; All other regions: 31 Mar 2026 (closed)
eligibility_summary: Non-EU tuition fee status only. Must hold an offer or conditional offer for an eligible undergraduate or graduate taught programme at UCD. Some programmes excluded.

title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES) 2026/27
provider: Higher Education Authority (HEA) / Government of Ireland
eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss/UK domiciled students with an offer from an eligible Irish HEI for full-time NFQ Level 9 or 10 study. Must not have previously held a GOI-IES scholarship.
funding_details: Full tuition fee waiver + €10,000 stipend for one year.
